tray.status_error: The last automatic run could not start
setup.title: Let's connect your invoice mailbox
setup.lead: Docsweep reads this mailbox, saves invoices as named PDF files and tidies up afterwards. Nothing changes until you have seen a preview.
setup.only_imap: Works with IMAP and a password or app password. Mailboxes that require OAuth2, such as Microsoft 365, are not supported.
setup.broken_lead: Docsweep could not use this file. Please correct it and start again.
mailbox.field.password_stored: Stored in the system keychain. Type here to replace it.
mailbox.field.password_hint: Goes straight into the system keychain, never into a file.
mailbox.title: Mailboxes
mailbox.remove_text: Docsweep stops reading this mailbox. Its mails and your saved invoices stay where they are.
mailbox.last_one: Docsweep needs at least one mailbox.
cleanup.title: After an invoice is saved
cleanup.lead: The default for all companies. Each company can override it.
cleanup.pdf_move_link_delete: Move PDF mails, delete link mails
cleanup.pdf_move_link_delete_hint: Keeps mails with invoices as a record. Link mails are deleted once their invoice is stored.
cleanup.all_move_hint: Nothing gets deleted. Everything ends up in one folder.
cleanup.all_delete_hint: Your inbox stays empty. The saved PDF is your record.
cleanup.folder_hint: Created if it does not exist. Use / between levels.
cleanup.trash: Deleting moves mails to the trash
cleanup.trash_hint: Recommended. Without a trash folder on the server, mails stay where they are.
cleanup.permanent_warning: Deleted mails are gone for good and cannot be restored.
cleanup.safety: A mail is only touched after its invoice is saved and indexed.
scan.title: Scan
scan.idle_title: See what is waiting in your inbox
scan.idle_lead: A preview changes nothing: no files, no flags, no moved mails. You decide afterwards.
scan.no_companies: Add a company first, so Docsweep knows which mails are invoices.
scan.empty_lead: No mail in your mailboxes matches a company right now.
scan.preview_note: Preview. Nothing has been changed yet.
scan.nothing_to_run: Nothing to save or tidy up.
scan.confirm_text: This is the real run. A mail is only touched after its invoice is saved and indexed.
scan.confirm_reviews_one: Save {count} file for review; its mail stays
scan.confirm_reviews_other: Save {count} files for review; their mails stay
scan.confirm_fetches_one: Start a portal download for {count} company; link mails are only tidied up once their invoice is saved
scan.confirm_fetches_other: Start portal downloads for {count} companies; link mails are only tidied up once their invoice is saved
scan.auto_running: Docsweep is running automatically right now. You can start a scan when it has finished.
row.review_conflict: Number known with a different file
row.portal: Noted for a later portal download
row.portal_due: A real run starts the portal download
row.portal_checked_today: The portal was already checked today; it is checked again tomorrow
row.portal_waiting: Not in the portal yet. Docsweep checks again later, at most once a day
row.no_document: No PDF, and no portal configured
row.fetch_missing: The portal offers no document for this yet
row.recipe_repaired: {provider} repaired the step {step}, and the recipe was saved. Please check the change. The previous recipe is kept as {file}.
row.repair_possible: The step {step} no longer matches. A real run could try to repair it with your AI provider. A preview sends nothing.
invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.lead: Everything Docsweep has saved or noted.
invoices.empty_lead: They appear here after your first scan.
review.title: Complete this invoice
review.lead: Open the file, then enter what Docsweep could not read. The file is renamed, and the next scan tidies up its mail.
companies.title: Companies
companies.lead: Who sends you invoices, and how they are filed.
companies.empty_lead: Add the companies that send you invoices. Docsweep recognises their mails by the sender's domain.
companies.select: Select a company to edit it.
companies.field.name: Name
companies.section.mails_lead: All conditions you fill in must match. Subdomains count as well.
companies.field.subject: Subject pattern
companies.field.dir_no_default: Required, because no default folder is set under Settings.
companies.discard_text: What you entered here will be lost.
companies.disposal.delete_trash: Moves the mail to the trash.
companies.disposal.delete_permanent: Deletes the mail permanently, as set under Settings.
companies.portal.toggle: Invoices are also in a customer portal
companies.portal.mode: How invoices get out of the portal
companies.portal.mode_recipe_hint: Docsweep logs in with a recipe and downloads what is new. This works for most portals.
companies.portal.mode_assisted_hint: For portals that turn away automated browsers, for example with a Cloudflare check. When a link mail arrives, Docsweep shows an invoice to pick up. One click opens the portal in your usual browser, you log in and download the PDF as always, and Docsweep files it after you confirm. No password is stored, and nothing runs on its own.
companies.portal.url_hint: The page that opens in your browser, usually the login page. It starts with https:// or http://.
companies.portal.note: Docsweep logs in with a recipe file and downloads what is new. You can start this here, a link mail starts it during a real scan, and a schedule can start it too. A link mail is only tidied up once its invoice is saved.
companies.portal.recipe_hint: Relative paths start in the recipes folder of Docsweep's data directory.
companies.portal.login_hint: Both go straight into the system keychain, never into a file.
companies.portal.login_stored: Stored in the system keychain. To replace them, enter both again.
companies.portal.both_required: Please enter user name and password together.
companies.portal.totp_hint: Only if the portal uses an authenticator app. Goes straight into the system keychain.
companies.portal.totp_stored: Stored in the system keychain. Type here to replace it.
companies.delete_text: Docsweep stops recognising its mails. Saved invoices and index entries stay.
recipe.title: Make a recipe
recipe.lead: Instead of writing a recipe by hand, record one in a browser or let your AI provider write a draft. Either way you get a draft to check with Fetch now.
recipe.address_hint: The login page, or the list of invoices.
recipe.address_missing: Please enter the address of the portal.
recipe.describe_hint: For example where the invoices are. Sent with the page, so leave out anything private.
recipe.generate_off: To generate recipes, set up an AI provider under Settings.
recipe.send_lead: Docsweep opened the page without logging in and cleaned it: field values, tokens, addresses' query strings, mail addresses and long numbers are gone. Names and postal addresses in the text can remain. This is exactly what goes out, with Docsweep's fixed instructions.
recipe.host_title: This draft leaves the portal's host
recipe.host_text: A portal page can try to talk a language model into this. Only keep the draft if you recognise the new host: login data would go there.
recipe.replace_text: {file} already exists and would be replaced.
recipe.recording_lead: A browser window has opened. Log in as usual, go to your invoices, and click one document link in the list. Docsweep notes where you click and type, and never what you type.
recipe.saved: Draft saved as {file} in the recipes folder.
recipe.used: Now press Save, then Fetch now to check it. A preview downloads nothing.
ai.title: AI help
ai.lead: Off until you set it up. With your own API key, a language model can write recipe drafts, and repair a recipe whose file says `ai_fallback: repair_step`. It never sees passwords, codes or cookies, and portal runs work without it.
ai.enabled_hint: Before a page goes to a provider for the first time, you see exactly what is sent.
ai.model_default: Empty uses {model}. It is a powerful model, and your provider bills you for it.
ai.model_required: The name of a model your provider offers. Required for this provider.
ai.key_hint: Goes straight into the system keychain, never into a file.
ai.key_stored: Stored in the system keychain. Type here to replace it.
ai.repair_lead: A step of this recipe no longer matches the portal. This is the first time this company's pages would go to {provider}, and this is exactly what goes out, with Docsweep's fixed instructions. Later repairs for this company go without asking, and every one is shown in the history.
schedule.label: Schedule
schedule.none: Five cron fields: minute, hour, day, month, weekday. Empty means no schedule.
schedule.automation_off: Automatic runs are off under Settings, so it does not start yet.
fetch.needs_saving: Save this company before fetching from its portal.
fetch.preview_note: Preview. Nothing has been downloaded yet.
fetch.confirm_text: New documents are saved and added to the index. Known ones are not downloaded again.
confirmation.title: {name} needs you
confirmation.detected: The portal asks for a confirmation or a captcha. Please finish it in the browser window, then continue here.
confirmation.timed_out: This took too long: {step}. If the browser window needs something from you, please finish it, then continue here.
confirmation.limit: Docsweep waits for up to {seconds} seconds. If you cancel or the time runs out, this fetch ends as failed.
history.title: History
history.lead: Every real run. Previews change nothing and are not listed, and neither are automatic checks that found nothing.
history.empty_lead: After your first real run, you can see here what happened to each mail.
history.nothing: Nothing to do in this run.
settings.title: Settings
settings.folder.title: Where invoices go
settings.folder.label: Default folder
settings.folder.hint: Companies use this folder unless you choose another one for them.
settings.folder.moved_note: Changing it applies to new invoices. Files already saved stay where they are.
settings.downloads.title: Picking up invoices
settings.downloads.lead: While you pick up an invoice in your browser, Docsweep looks in this folder for new PDFs. At no other time, and it opens nothing else there.
settings.downloads.label: Downloads folder
settings.downloads.hint: Empty uses your system's downloads folder. Choose the folder your browser saves to.
automation.title: Automatic runs
automation.lead: Off until you turn it on. Docsweep then works on its own whenever it is open, even with its window closed, as long as it stays in the tray.
automation.warning: Automatic runs save invoices and clean up mails without a preview: mails are moved or deleted by your rules, with nobody looking first. A mail is still only touched after its invoice is saved. You can see what happened under History.
automation.enabled: Run automatically while Docsweep is open
automation.enabled_hint: Starts company schedules and mailbox checks. A schedule missed while Docsweep was closed runs once at the next start.
automation.poll_hint: At least 5. Empty means mailboxes are only read when you start a scan.
automation.poll_invalid: Please enter a whole number of minutes.
automation.autostart_hint: Applies right away. Docsweep then starts in the tray, without a window.
